agent_final_answer:
Browsed Humira dosage information at drugs.com (Dosage page: /dosage/humira.html). Key details:

Drug: Humira - Generic name adalimumab (40mg in 0.8mL injection). Dosage form: injection. Drug classes: Antirheumatics, TNF alfa inhibitors. Prescription only. Last updated Dec 23, 2025.

Recommended dosages by condition:
- Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA), Psoriatic Arthritis (PsA), Ankylosing Spondylitis (AS), adults: 40 mg subcutaneously every other week. Some RA patients not on methotrexate may benefit from 40 mg every week or 80 mg every other week.
- Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis / Pediatric Uveitis (age 2+), by weight: 10-15 kg = 10 mg every other week; 15-30 kg = 20 mg every other week; 30 kg and greater = 40 mg every other week.
- Crohn's Disease, adults: 160 mg on Day 1 (single day or split over two days), 80 mg on Day 15, then 40 mg every other week starting Day 29.
- Crohn's Disease, pediatric (age 6+): 17 to <40 kg = 80 mg Day 1, 40 mg Day 15, then 20 mg every other week; 40 kg+ = 160 mg Day 1, 80 mg Day 15, then 40 mg every other week.
- Ulcerative Colitis, adults: 160 mg Day 1, 80 mg Day 15, then 40 mg every other week from Day 29; discontinue if no remission by week 8 (Day 57).
- Plaque Psoriasis / adult Uveitis: initial 80 mg, then 40 mg every other week starting one week after the initial dose.
- Hidradenitis Suppurativa, adults: 160 mg Day 1, 80 mg Day 15, then 40 mg weekly or 80 mg every other week from Day 29.

Administration: subcutaneous via HUMIRA Pen or prefilled syringe; inject in thigh or abdomen, rotating sites; may be self-injected after training. Tuberculosis evaluation recommended prior to initiation. If a dose is missed, administer as soon as possible then resume regular schedule.
